text: Before dawn, on the sixth of June, nineteen forty-four.
asr: Before dawn on the 6th of June, 1944.

text: Ships left ports all along the south coast of England.
sub: Ships left ports all along the south coast of England.

text: They gathered south of the Isle of Wight, in an area sailors called Piccadilly Circus.
sub: They gathered south of the Isle of Wight: "Piccadilly Circus".
asr: They gathered south of the Isle of Wight in an area sailors called Piccadilly Circus.

text: Nearly seven thousand vessels crossed the Channel.
Their targets: five beaches, along about eighty kilometres of Normandy.
sub: Their targets: five beaches along about 80 km of Normandy.
asr: Their targets, five beaches along about 80 kilometers of Normandy.

text: Near Omaha, American Rangers climbed the thirty metre cliffs of Pwant doo Ock.
sub: Near Omaha, US Rangers climbed the 30 m cliffs of Pointe du Hoc.
asr: Near Omaha, American rangers climbed the 30-metre cliffs of Piwant-Duoc.

text: By nightfall, about a hundred and fifty-six thousand Allied troops had landed, by sea and by air.
sub: By nightfall, about 156,000 Allied troops had landed, by sea and air.
asr: By nightfall, about 156,000 Allied troops had landed by sea and by air.

text: The way back into Europe was open.
sub: The way back into Europe was open.
